title: Weekly Stories & Demos — Playback Journal
content:
Purpose: a compact weekly scratchpad to convert demos and short stories into measurable micro-goals. I use this to: 1) capture a one-sentence outcome for the week, 2) log two demo stories I showed or practiced, 3) convert each story into a concrete next step (owner: me), and 4) pick 1 micro-metric to watch. Keeps the week focused and the demo loop short.

One-sentence weekly outcome:
- Ship a smaller, testable demo of the inference-fallback flow so we can validate latency regression behavior with 95th percentile under the canary model.

Stories / Demos (playback):
1) Story: "Fallback in action" live run-through (5m)
   - What I did: Walked through scenario where model A times out and we fall back to A-quantized variant. Highlighted metrics and log traces.
   - What landed: team saw end-to-end timeline; SRE spotted an unusual retry burst at 120s.
   - Emotional signal: felt rushed; ran over the noisy parts.
   - Demo artifacts: short recording + trace link (linked_artifacts above).

2) Story: "Prefix caching sanity check" (3m)
   - What I did: Showed a sample user session where repeated prefixes hit cache and reduced token generation time.
   - What landed: product PM asked for a small dashboard tile that shows cache hit ratio per route.
   - Emotional signal: clean, concise; audience engaged.

Concrete next steps (owner = me unless noted):
- A: Create a trimmed demo script for "Fallback in action" (3 bullets, <120s) — due Tue 11/04 — DONE (recording 11/05).
- B: Open a short SRE follow-up ticket for retry behavior linked to fallback decisions — JIRA-4881 — ASSIGNED to SRE (Devon) — due 11/07.
- C: Draft a one-line spec for "cache hit tile" and ping PM (Maya) for prioritization — draft sent 11/06 — waiting on response.
- D: Add a short checklist to the demo runbook: required logs, snapshot command, minimal seeding prompt — in progress.

Micro-metrics (signals to watch this week):
- Demo readiness: recording + runbook present (binary) — target = true.
- 95th pct latency during demo runs: baseline 620ms -> goal <= 700ms in canary window.
- Cache hit ratio on sample route: baseline 14% -> target >= 25% for user session test.

Confidence rating (1–5): 3.5
- Why not 5: SRE dependency on retry investigation, and I want to compress the fallback demo into <2 minutes which requires surgical editing.

Risks / Blockers:
- Blocker: CI snapshotting sometimes fails when sequence length > 1024 in sandbox — slows demo retake. (Mitigation: add a short synthetic session that stays at 512 tokens.)
- Risk: PM deprioritizes cache tile if other dashboard work consumes cycles.

Micro-experiments to run next week (1–2 small, time-boxed):
- Experiment A: Replace the long trace view with a 3-line TL;DR section and see whether demo retention (measured by follow-up questions in Slack) improves. Time-box: 2 hours to author.
- Experiment B: Run three demo rehearsals with colleagues and ask them for a single improvement suggestion; iterate to a 90s script. Time-box: 4 rehearsals.

Retro notes (what I learned from this week's demos):
- Short, concrete narratives beat completeness: audience remembers the "what happened" not the edge-case timeline.
- Always lead with the observable metric (e.g., 95th latency) and the expected change. That frames the story.
- Prepare a visible fallback decision map: when we fall back, what traces do folks look at first? Ship that as a single slide.

Questions / To ask others:
- @Maya: if cache tile is low priority, would a temporary README with cache hit examples suffice to unblock the PM ask? (Slack thread linked)
- @Devon: can we get the retry job reproduced locally? If not, I'll prepare a short synthetic to illustrate.

Quick wins to close before next weekly check-in:
- Finalize the 90s fallback script and record a short clip — target: 11/09 EOD.
- Attach demo checklist to the runbook and push to repo — target: 11/08.
- Confirm SRE ticket ownership and add acceptance criteria — target: 11/07.

Personal notes / feelings (scratchpad):
- Felt rushed in the live run; when I practice it, the pacing is fine. Need to reduce cognitive load in the demo (less on-screen lines).
- Good energy from team on cache stats; maybe low-hanging product impact.

Appendix (templates):
- Demo TL;DR (90s): 1 line setup, 1 line expectation, 2 lines of the observable outcome, 1 line call-to-action.
- Runbook checklist (minimal): pre-seed prompt, snapshot command, log tail command, link to recording location.

End of week note: overall decent traction. Focus next week on trimming demos, locking SRE follow-up, and converting one demo insight into a product ticket.
